name: Windows junk apps
description: Games, adverts and extra apps that came with Windows. Ticked ones are rarely used. Unticked ones are your choice.

items.name: Candy Crush and other King games
items.description: Advertising games that come with Windows. They're free to download again if you want them.

items.name: Gameloft games
items.description: Advertising games, such as March of Empires, that come with Windows.

items.name: Microsoft Solitaire Collection
items.description: Card games including Solitaire and FreeCell. Keep it if you play them.

items.name: Tips
items.description: Shows tips about Windows features. Most people never open it.

items.name: Feedback Hub
items.description: Sends feedback about Windows to Microsoft. Most people never use it.

items.name: Mixed Reality Portal
items.description: Only needed for virtual reality headsets.

items.name: 3D Viewer
items.description: Opens 3D model files. Most people never use it.

items.name: Print 3D
items.description: Sends designs to a 3D printer. Only useful if you have one.

items.name: Paint 3D
items.description: A 3D drawing app Microsoft no longer updates. The normal Paint app isn't affected.

items.name: Mobile Plans
items.description: Sells mobile data plans for PCs with a SIM card slot.

items.name: Microsoft Messaging
items.description: An old messaging app Microsoft no longer supports.

items.name: Microsoft Pay
items.description: An old payments app Microsoft no longer supports.

items.name: Cortana
items.description: Microsoft's old voice assistant, which no longer works in most countries.

items.name: Money
items.description: An old finance news app Microsoft no longer supports.

items.name: Sports
items.description: An old sports news app Microsoft no longer supports.

items.name: Power Automate
items.description: A tool for automating office tasks. Most home users never use it.

items.name: Microsoft News
items.description: A news app. Keep it if you read the news with it.

items.name: Weather
items.description: A weather forecast app. Keep it if you use it.

items.name: Maps
items.description: A maps and directions app. Keep it if you use it.

items.name: Microsoft 365 (Office) app
items.description: Advertises Microsoft 365. Your Word, Excel and other Office programs aren't affected.

items.name: Skype
items.description: Video calling app. Microsoft has replaced it with Teams. Keep it if you still use it.

items.name: People
items.description: An address book app. Keep it if you use the Mail app.

items.name: Movies & TV
items.description: Plays videos and films bought from Microsoft. Keep it if you use it.

items.name: Media Player (Groove Music)
items.description: Plays music and videos stored on your PC. Keep it if you use it.

items.name: Clipchamp
items.description: A video editor. Keep it if you make videos.

items.name: Microsoft To Do
items.description: A to-do list app. Keep it if you use it.

items.name: Microsoft Family Safety
items.description: Parental controls. Keep it if you use it to look after children's accounts.

items.name: Xbox Console Companion
items.description: An old Xbox app. Keep it if you play Xbox games on this PC.

items.name: Xbox
items.description: The Xbox app for PC games. Keep it if you play games from Xbox or Game Pass.

items.name: Phone Link
items.description: Connects your phone to your PC. Keep it if you use it.

items.name: Spotify
items.description: Music streaming. Often comes with new PCs. Keep it if you use it.

items.name: Netflix
items.description: Often comes with new PCs. You can still watch Netflix in your web browser.

items.name: Disney+
items.description: Often comes with new PCs. You can still watch Disney+ in your web browser.

items.name: Prime Video
items.description: Often comes with new PCs. You can still watch Prime Video in your web browser.

items.name: TikTok
items.description: Often comes with new PCs. Keep it if you use it.

items.name: Facebook and Instagram
items.description: Often come with new PCs. You can still use them in your web browser.

items.name: X (Twitter)
items.description: Often comes with new PCs. You can still use it in your web browser.

items.name: Pandora
items.description: A music streaming advert that came with Windows.

items.name: Eclipse Manager
items.description: A note-taking advert that came with Windows.

items.name: Code Writer
items.description: A programming text editor advert that came with Windows.

items.name: Booking.com
items.description: A travel booking advert that came with Windows.

items.name: Adobe Photoshop Express
items.description: A photo editing advert that came with Windows. Keep it if you use it.

items.name: Duolingo
items.description: A language learning advert that came with Windows. Keep it if you use it.

items.name: Flipboard
items.description: A news reading advert that came with Windows.

items.name: Shazam
items.description: A music recognition advert that came with Windows.

items.name: WildTangent Games
items.description: Trial games that came with your PC. They often show adverts and ask you to pay.
